summary: The cache-generation guard prevents an in-flight pre-save read from replacing the cache primed by a successful admin save, and the added test exercises that race.

evidence: src/provider/selection.ts increments the cache generation after a successful save and only installs a read result when its captured generation is still current (lines 147-148 and 229-235).
tests/provider-selection.test.ts defers the selection read, performs an admin save, releases the read, and verifies the saved value remains cached (lines 295-321).
